title: ORCA Memory Live Activation Roadmap

format_decision.reason: This activation track must be executable by PlanRuntime and ABC automation. Markdown plans remain reference history only.

name_contract.legacy_rule: New roadmap language uses ORCA. Existing plugins/obsidian paths, obsidian_* tools, /api/plugins/obsidian routes, .obsidian metadata, and ODYSSEUS_OBSIDIAN_* env vars are legacy compatibility surfaces until the ORCA migration roadmap closes their removal gates.

goal: Bring ORCA Memory Tree UI, Freshness filtering, Quarantine, Derived Graph edges, Hybrid Retrieval, and RAPTOR graph/rebuild into verified live operation on the server.

done_definition.feature_done_means: Implemented, focused tests green, committed, pushed to the current integration branch, live-installed on the server, and verified through live health/API checks.
final_goal_reached_when: ORCA Memory Tree UI is enabled live and visible.
Freshness Gate reports filtering_state=active and excludes isolated knowledge from default retrieval.
Quarantine has a meaningful active path when isolated items exist and is no longer logically dead.
Derived Graph has audited edges with provenance for the current vault baseline.
RAPTOR is enabled, rebuilt through the write gate, has index and summaries, returns nonzero graph nodes when source notes exist, and exposes bounded graph views.
Readiness Gate no longer blocks on Freshness or RAPTOR for the configured live vault.
All roadmap evidence is recorded in this JSON plan after live verification.

disabled_systems.cause: ORCA flag aliases exist, but the canonical runtime gate still maps to obsidian_raptor_enabled=false and obsidian_raptor_rebuild_enabled=false by default.
ORCA flag aliases exist, but the canonical runtime gate still maps to obsidian_hybrid_retrieval_enabled=false by default.
ORCA flag aliases exist, but the canonical runtime gate still maps to obsidian_memory_tree_ui_enabled=false by default.

limited_systems.cause: Freshness filtering only becomes active when Hybrid Retrieval is enabled.
Quarantine is observable but cannot affect default retrieval until filtering is active.
Two nodes exist but no explicit wiki links or accepted edge relations connect them.

non_goals: No provider calls or LLM-generated RAPTOR summaries in this activation track.
No mutation of user note content without an explicit operator-approved slice.
No automatic global RAPTOR rebuild loop before operator-gated rebuild policy is verified.
No raw note bodies, secrets, private provider output, chat IDs, or absolute host paths in roadmap evidence.
No force-push, destructive git, or unrelated UI/sidebar rework in this track.
stop_rules: Stop on foreign staged files, secrets, token leakage, or hotfile conflicts.
Stop if focused tests remain red after one scoped fix attempt.
Stop before any live server write, deploy, env change, RAPTOR rebuild, or vault mutation without explicit operator Go for that live action.
Stop if live /api/health, /api/version, Chroma heartbeat, or ORCA memory routes fail after deployment.
Stop if Freshness filtering would remove all usable context without a visible audit trail.
Stop if RAPTOR rebuild would persist raw note content, absolute paths, provider output, or unbounded graph payloads.
Stop if the live vault path or owner context is ambiguous.

release_go_language.go: All focused tests pass, live install succeeded, health checks pass, feature status proves ready/active, and evidence is committed.
release_go_language.partial: Code is live but one non-blocking readiness family remains audit-only with explicit follow-up node.
release_go_language.no_go: Tests fail, feature flag state is ambiguous, live health fails, or write safety evidence is missing.
release_go_language.deferred: The operator intentionally keeps a capability read-only after evidence shows it is safe but not desired yet.

version_horizons.label: 0.9 Activation
version_horizons.target: Turn visible read-only/audit foundations into live, operator-verifiable features.

version_horizons.label: 0.10 Hardening
version_horizons.target: Keep RAPTOR rebuild and graph memory safe under ongoing live use.

graph_nodes.title: Live memory baseline audit
deliverables: Structured baseline report for live flags, readiness families, graph counts, quarantine counts, and RAPTOR status.
Read-only GET /api/plugins/orca/memory/baseline route returns a summary-only activation evidence packet without raw note bodies, absolute host paths, or provider output.
Explicit operator Go/No-Go recommendation for each activation slice.

abc.reason: Read-only live and local evidence must be gathered before enabling write or filtering behavior.

verification: Legacy fallback check: GET /api/plugins/obsidian/memory/status remains compatible until removal gates close.

graph_nodes.title: ORCA Memory Tree UI live enablement
deliverables: ORCA Memory Tree UI visible behind explicit feature flag or live config.
Live UI/API evidence shows tree, audit, quarantine, and RAPTOR status surfaces.

abc.reason: Small frontend/config activation with focused static tests.

verification: Live browser/API check for ORCA Memory Tree UI visibility.

graph_nodes.title: Canonical vault foundation and explicit links
deliverables: Operator-approved canonical note set or documented deferrals for User Preferences, Odysseus Architecture, ORCA Local Markdown Vault Rules, and Open Decisions.
At least one explicit graph link from _state/active_run.md or accepted alternative source.

abc.reason: Operator-facing wording and vault content changes need narrow, reviewable scope.

verification: Vault audit reports no unintended orphan for active state.
Derived graph source scan sees explicit link candidates.

graph_nodes.title: Derived Graph edges live
deliverables: Derived Graph emits nonzero edges when source notes contain explicit relationships.
Edge provenance and type are visible enough for audit and safe future agent context.

abc.reason: Backend graph behavior and tests need a narrow implementation slice.

verification: Live /api/plugins/orca/raptor/graph reports expected bounded edge_count after rebuild.

graph_nodes.title: Hybrid Retrieval and Freshness filtering live
deliverables: Hybrid Retrieval enabled live.
Freshness Gate changes from audit_only to active filtering.
Retrieval policy reports default_retrieval_is_filtered=true and excluded relevant counts when appropriate.

abc.reason: Retrieval behavior needs focused test coverage and live verification.

graph_nodes.title: Quarantine live behavior
deliverables: Quarantine is not merely a dead audit list; it has observable impact on default retrieval when relevant items exist.
UI/API still lets the operator inspect isolated items and reasons.

abc.reason: Operator wording and quarantine inspection behavior must be clear before marking readiness green.

verification: Live quarantine route/UI shows isolated items when test/live vault contains them.

graph_nodes.title: RAPTOR rebuild live
deliverables: ORCA RAPTOR flags are enabled only with explicit operator Go.
Live rebuild writes index, summaries, and rebuild_report artifacts.
RAPTOR status reports configured=true and write gate readiness evidence.

abc.reason: This is the first write-capable live action and requires integration, deploy, and evidence discipline.

verification: Live POST /api/plugins/orca/raptor/rebuild only after operator Go.

graph_nodes.title: RAPTOR read policy and rebuild gate
deliverables: RAPTOR graph reads remain available live.
Further rebuilds remain explicit/operator-gated or policy-gated.
Dirty or tainted lineage prevents false green readiness.

abc.reason: Runtime policy and cache behavior need tests before long-running automation can rely on them.

verification: Live status remains bounded and cache diagnostics are stable after refresh.

graph_nodes.title: Readiness Gate live green
deliverables: Readiness Gate no longer blocks on Freshness or RAPTOR in live configuration.
Mission status surfaces memory diagnostics as green or explicitly deferred, not silent.

abc.reason: Final integration gate requires local tests, live deploy, and evidence update.

verification: Live ORCA memory status and RAPTOR status.

graph_nodes.title: ABC continuation until all live
deliverables: A 1-minute Charlie heartbeat can continue this roadmap slice by slice until every developed feature is live.
Automation stops only on roadmap completion or explicit stop rule.

abc.reason: Automation policy must be integrated after the feature chain is live.

verification: Automation prompt references this roadmap path.
Next claimable node selection uses PlanRuntime dependencies.

plan_graph_projection.edge_policy: depends_on and unlocks edges are authoritative for claimability. Collision and live-Go gates block dispatch even when dependencies are complete.

next_actions.action: Requires explicit operator Go before any vault note mutation; read-only prep only until then.
Remain blocked until canonical vault foundation creates explicit source links.
Remain blocked until memory-tree-ui-live and derived-graph-edges-live are both live.

roles.alice: Docs, operator wording, canonical note/link contract, quarantine inspection language, Go/No-Go language.
roles.bob: Focused backend/frontend tests, graph/retrieval implementation slices, cache/read policy behavior.
roles.charlie: Scope control, live gates, commits, pushes, deploys, roadmap evidence, automation, final readiness.

parallelism_policy: Parallel work is allowed only when path scopes do not overlap.
Exactly one feature may move through live install at a time.
After each live install, update this roadmap evidence before selecting the next claimable node.
Live env changes, vault writes, and RAPTOR rebuilds require explicit operator Go.

per_feature_sequence: Check git status and stop on foreign staged files or hotfile conflicts.
Update this roadmap completion_state with commit and live evidence.
Commit/push the evidence update and install it live before starting the next feature.
